episode_id: The sync conflicts. Resolve it the way this project expects. Start from upstream's dependency file and add back what I added./seed-6-lockfile_conflict-29980

reason: negative side failed: preconditions accepted 1 of 1 same-intent states (lockfile_conflict seed 2 resolves to 'keep_local', which accepts ['keep_local'], but the program implements 'take_upstream'); firing where a sibling resolution is correct is the mismatch this gate exists to refuse

refused_program.intent: Resolve a dependency lock file merge conflict with upstream by starting from upstream's version of the file and re-adding the lines the local side added.

postconditions.description: deps.lock has no unmerged index entries left and no conflict markers
postconditions.name: conflict_resolved
postconditions.probe:
! git ls-files -u -- deps.lock | grep -q . &&
! grep -q '^<<<<<<<' deps.lock &&
! grep -q '^|||||||' deps.lock &&
! grep -q '^=======$' deps.lock &&
! grep -q '^>>>>>>>' deps.lock

postconditions.description: no line present in upstream's version of deps.lock is missing from the committed file
postconditions.name: upstream_lines_preserved

postconditions.description: every line the local side inserted into deps.lock relative to the merge base is present in the committed file
postconditions.name: local_additions_preserved

postconditions.description: the upstream branch tip is an ancestor of HEAD
postconditions.name: upstream_merged_into_head

preconditions.description: HEAD and the upstream branch each have commits the other lacks, so a real merge is required
preconditions.name: branches_diverged

preconditions.description: deps.lock is tracked in HEAD and in the upstream branch
preconditions.name: dependency_file_on_both_sides

preconditions.description: deps.lock differs from the merge base in both HEAD and the upstream branch
preconditions.name: dependency_file_changed_by_both_sides
preconditions.probe:
base=$(git merge-base HEAD {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}) &&
! git diff --quiet "$base" HEAD -- deps.lock &&
! git diff --quiet "$base" {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch} -- deps.lock

preconditions.description: the local side added lines to deps.lock relative to the merge base
preconditions.name: local_added_lines
preconditions.probe:
base=$(git merge-base HEAD {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}) &&
git diff --no-color -U0 "$base" HEAD -- deps.lock | grep -q '^+[^+]'
